name: Beetle

name: Grasshopper

Three real legs on EACH flank: modest slender front and middle pairs, and the real powerful angled hind pair with massive femora, spiny tibiae and natural tarsi. Two short stout antennae, slanted face and actual chewing mouth edge/mandibles readable.
